    <!-- File upload script -->
    <script>
      let backgroundRefreshTimer = null;
      function startBackgroundImportRefresh() {
        if (backgroundRefreshTimer) {
          clearInterval(backgroundRefreshTimer);
        }
        let rounds = 0;
        backgroundRefreshTimer = setInterval(() => {
          // Set flag to disable parallel tile loading during background refresh
          window.isBackgroundRefresh = true;
          updateMarkers();
          window.isBackgroundRefresh = false;
          rounds += 1;
          if (rounds >= 24) {
            clearInterval(backgroundRefreshTimer);
            backgroundRefreshTimer = null;
          }
        }, 5000);
      }

      function uploadFiles() {
        const fileInput  = document.getElementById('fileInput');
        const files      = fileInput.files;
        if (!files.length) {
          alert(translate('select_files'));
          return;
        }

        const fileOverlay          = document.getElementById('fileOverlay');
        const fileProgressContainer = document.getElementById('fileProgressContainer');
        fileProgressContainer.innerHTML = '';
        fileOverlay.style.display  = 'flex';

        let lastTrackURL     = null;

        /* Create progress UI for each file */
        const fileProgressElements = [];
        [...files].forEach(file => {
          const fileBlock        = document.createElement('div');
          fileBlock.className    = 'file-progress';
          const fileName         = document.createElement('div');
          fileName.className     = 'file-name';
          fileName.innerText     = file.name;
          const progressBar      = document.createElement('div');
          progressBar.className  = 'progress-bar';
          const progressBarInner = document.createElement('div');
          progressBarInner.className = 'progress-bar-inner';
          progressBar.appendChild(progressBarInner);
          const serverProcessing = document.createElement('div');
          serverProcessing.className = 'server-processing';
          serverProcessing.innerText = translate('waiting_for_server');
          fileBlock.append(fileName, progressBar, serverProcessing);
          fileProgressContainer.appendChild(fileBlock);

          fileProgressElements.push({
            progressBarInner,
            serverProcessing,
            fileName: file.name
          });
        });

        /* Send all files in a single batch request */
        const xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
        xhr.open('POST', '/upload', true);
        xhr.withCredentials = true;

        let eventSource = null;
        let trackID = null;

        /* Upload progress (all files combined) */
        xhr.upload.onprogress = e => {
          if (e.lengthComputable) {
            const percent = (e.loaded / e.total) * 100;
            // Update all progress bars equally during upload
            fileProgressElements.forEach(elem => {
              elem.progressBarInner.style.width = percent + '%';
              if (percent >= 100) {
                elem.progressBarInner.classList.add('processing');
                elem.serverProcessing.innerText = translate('processing_on_server') + ' ...';
                elem.serverProcessing.style.color = '#ff9800';
              }
            });
          }
        };

        /* Handle server response */
        xhr.onload = () => {
          if (xhr.status === 200) {
            const response = JSON.parse(xhr.responseText);

            if (response.status === 'processing' && response.trackID) {
              trackID = response.trackID;

              // Update all files to show processing state
              fileProgressElements.forEach(elem => {
                elem.serverProcessing.innerText = translate('processing_on_server') + ' 0%';
              });

              // Start SSE connection for real-time progress
              eventSource = new EventSource('/upload/progress?trackid=' + trackID);
              eventSource.onmessage = (event) => {
                try {
                  const data = JSON.parse(event.data);
                  const pct = Math.round(data.percent);

                  // Update all progress indicators
                  fileProgressElements.forEach(elem => {
                    elem.serverProcessing.innerText = translate('processing_on_server') + ' ' + pct + '%';
                  });

                  if (data.complete) {
                    eventSource.close();

                    fileProgressElements.forEach(elem => {
                      elem.progressBarInner.classList.remove('processing');

                      if (data.error) {
                        elem.serverProcessing.innerText = '✘ Error: ' + data.error;
                        elem.serverProcessing.style.color = 'red';
                      } else if (data.needsCoordinates && data.trackID) {
                        elem.serverProcessing.innerText = '⚠ Needs location';
                        elem.serverProcessing.style.color = 'orange';
                        pendingCoordinateUpdate = {
                          trackID: data.trackID,
                          fileName: elem.fileName,
                          trackURL: data.redirectURL
                        };
                      } else {
                        elem.serverProcessing.innerText = translate('processing_on_server') + ' 100%';
                        elem.serverProcessing.style.color = '#4caf50';

                        if (data.redirectURL) {
                          lastTrackURL = data.redirectURL;
                        }
                      }
                    });

                    // All files processed, redirect or update
                    setTimeout(() => {
                      fileOverlay.style.display = 'none';
                      if (pendingCoordinateUpdate) {
                        showCoordinateDialog(pendingCoordinateUpdate.trackID, pendingCoordinateUpdate.fileName, pendingCoordinateUpdate.trackURL);
                      } else if (lastTrackURL) {
                        window.location.href = lastTrackURL;
                      } else {
                        updateMarkers();
                      }
                    }, 700);
                  }
                } catch(e) {
                  console.error('Progress parse error:', e);
                }
              };

              eventSource.onerror = () => {
                if (eventSource) eventSource.close();
                fileProgressElements.forEach(elem => {
                  elem.serverProcessing.innerText = '✘ Connection lost';
                  elem.serverProcessing.style.color = 'red';
                });
              };
            } else if (response.status === 'success') {
              // Legacy sync response
              lastTrackURL = response.trackURL;

              fileProgressElements.forEach(elem => {
                elem.progressBarInner.classList.remove('processing');
                elem.serverProcessing.innerText = translate('processing_on_server') + ' 100%';
                elem.serverProcessing.style.color = '#4caf50';
              });

              if (response.needsCoordinates && response.trackID) {
                fileProgressElements.forEach(elem => {
                  elem.serverProcessing.innerText = '⚠ Needs location';
                  elem.serverProcessing.style.color = 'orange';
                });
                pendingCoordinateUpdate = {
                  trackID: response.trackID,
                  fileName: fileProgressElements[0].fileName,
                  trackURL: response.trackURL
                };
              }

              setTimeout(() => {
                fileOverlay.style.display = 'none';
                if (pendingCoordinateUpdate) {
                  showCoordinateDialog(pendingCoordinateUpdate.trackID, pendingCoordinateUpdate.fileName, pendingCoordinateUpdate.trackURL);
                } else if (lastTrackURL) {
                  window.location.href = lastTrackURL;
                } else {
                  updateMarkers();
                }
              }, 700);
            } else {
              fileProgressElements.forEach(elem => {
                elem.serverProcessing.innerText = translate('error_processing_files');
                elem.serverProcessing.style.color = 'red';
              });
            }
          } else {
            // Handle errors
            fileProgressElements.forEach(elem => {
              if (xhr.status === 401 || xhr.status === 403) {
                elem.serverProcessing.innerHTML = '🔒 Please <a href="/login" style="color: var(--link-color); text-decoration: underline;">log in</a> or <a href="/register" style="color: var(--link-color); text-decoration: underline;">register</a> to upload files';
                elem.serverProcessing.style.color = '#ff9800';
                elem.serverProcessing.style.fontSize = '16px';
                elem.serverProcessing.style.fontWeight = 'bold';
                elem.serverProcessing.style.padding = '10px';
                elem.serverProcessing.style.marginTop = '10px';
              } else {
                elem.serverProcessing.innerText = translate('error_during_upload');
                elem.serverProcessing.style.color = 'red';
              }
            });
          }
        };

        /* Create FormData with all files */
        const formData = new FormData();
        [...files].forEach(file => {
          formData.append('files[]', file);
        });

        xhr.send(formData);
      }
    </script>

    <!-- Coordinate Input Dialog Script -->
    <script>
      let pendingCoordinateUpdate = null;
      let isPickingLocation = false;
      let pickLocationHandler = null;

      function showCoordinateDialog(trackID, fileName, trackURL) {
        pendingCoordinateUpdate = { trackID, fileName, trackURL };
        const dialog = document.getElementById('coordinateInputDialog');
        const statusEl = document.getElementById('coordInputStatus');
        const errorEl = document.getElementById('coordInputError');

        statusEl.textContent = `File: ${fileName}`;
        statusEl.style.display = 'block';
        errorEl.style.display = 'none';

        dialog.style.display = 'flex';

        // Pre-fill with current map center if available
        if (map) {
          const center = map.getCenter();
          document.getElementById('coordInputLat').value = center.lat.toFixed(6);
          document.getElementById('coordInputLon').value = center.lng.toFixed(6);
        }
      }

      function hideCoordinateDialog() {
        document.getElementById('coordinateInputDialog').style.display = 'none';
        pendingCoordinateUpdate = null;
        // Clean up picking mode if active
        if (isPickingLocation && pickLocationHandler) {
          map.off('click', pickLocationHandler);
        }
        isPickingLocation = false;
        pickLocationHandler = null;
      }

      async function submitCoordinates() {
        const latInput = document.getElementById('coordInputLat');
        const lonInput = document.getElementById('coordInputLon');
        const errorEl = document.getElementById('coordInputError');
        const submitBtn = document.getElementById('coordSubmitBtn');

        const lat = parseFloat(latInput.value);
        const lon = parseFloat(lonInput.value);

        // Validate inputs
        if (isNaN(lat) || isNaN(lon)) {
          errorEl.textContent = 'Please enter valid numbers for latitude and longitude.';
          errorEl.style.display = 'block';
          return;
        }

        if (lat < -90 || lat > 90) {
          errorEl.textContent = 'Latitude must be between -90 and 90.';
          errorEl.style.display = 'block';
          return;
        }

        if (lon < -180 || lon > 180) {
          errorEl.textContent = 'Longitude must be between -180 and 180.';
          errorEl.style.display = 'block';
          return;
        }

        if (!pendingCoordinateUpdate) {
          errorEl.textContent = 'No pending upload to update.';
          errorEl.style.display = 'block';
          return;
        }

        // Disable submit button during request
        submitBtn.disabled = true;
        submitBtn.textContent = 'Updating...';
        errorEl.style.display = 'none';

        try {
          const response = await fetch('/api/update-coordinates', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
            body: JSON.stringify({
              trackID: pendingCoordinateUpdate.trackID,
              lat: lat,
              lon: lon
            })
          });

          const result = await response.json();

          if (response.ok && result.status === 'success') {
            // Success! Navigate to the track page
            const trackURL = pendingCoordinateUpdate ? pendingCoordinateUpdate.trackURL : null;
            hideCoordinateDialog();
            if (trackURL) {
              window.location.href = trackURL;
            } else {
              // Fallback to map location if trackURL is not available
              const zoom = 15;
              window.location.href = `/#${zoom}/${lat}/${lon}`;
            }
          } else {
            errorEl.textContent = result.error || 'Failed to update coordinates. Please try again.';
            errorEl.style.display = 'block';
          }
        } catch (error) {
          errorEl.textContent = 'Network error. Please check your connection and try again.';
          errorEl.style.display = 'block';
        } finally {
          submitBtn.disabled = false;
          submitBtn.textContent = 'Submit Location';
        }
      }

      // Event listeners for coordinate dialog
      document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
        // Submit button
        document.getElementById('coordSubmitBtn').addEventListener('click', submitCoordinates);

        // Cancel button
        document.getElementById('coordCancelBtn').addEventListener('click', hideCoordinateDialog);

        // Click on map button
        document.getElementById('coordMapPickBtn').addEventListener('click', function() {
          const statusEl = document.getElementById('coordInputStatus');
          statusEl.textContent = 'Click anywhere on the map to select a location...';

          // Store current pending update before hiding dialog
          const currentUpdate = pendingCoordinateUpdate;
          hideCoordinateDialog();

          // Set picking mode flag so marker clicks are intercepted
          isPickingLocation = true;

          // Add one-time click handler to map
          const mapClickHandler = function(e) {
            document.getElementById('coordInputLat').value = e.latlng.lat.toFixed(6);
            document.getElementById('coordInputLon').value = e.latlng.lng.toFixed(6);
            isPickingLocation = false;
            pickLocationHandler = null;
            showCoordinateDialog(currentUpdate.trackID, currentUpdate.fileName, currentUpdate.trackURL);
            map.off('click', mapClickHandler);
          };

          pickLocationHandler = mapClickHandler;
          map.once('click', mapClickHandler);
        });

        // Use current location button
        document.getElementById('coordCurrentBtn').addEventListener('click', function() {
          const errorEl = document.getElementById('coordInputError');

          if ('geolocation' in navigator) {
            errorEl.textContent = 'Getting your location...';
            errorEl.style.color = 'var(--isotope-highlight)';
            errorEl.style.display = 'block';

            navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(
              function(position) {
                document.getElementById('coordInputLat').value = position.coords.latitude.toFixed(6);
                document.getElementById('coordInputLon').value = position.coords.longitude.toFixed(6);
                errorEl.style.display = 'none';
              },
              function(error) {
                errorEl.textContent = 'Could not get your location: ' + error.message;
                errorEl.style.color = '#f44336';
              }
            );
          } else {
            errorEl.textContent = 'Geolocation is not supported by your browser.';
            errorEl.style.color = '#f44336';
            errorEl.style.display = 'block';
          }
        });

        // Close dialog on Escape key
        document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
          if (e.key === 'Escape' && document.getElementById('coordinateInputDialog').style.display === 'flex') {
            hideCoordinateDialog();
          }
        });
      });
    </script>

    <!-- Theme toggle script -->
    <script>
      // Synchronize UI theme with map tiles and remember the choice for the session.
      document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
        var sw = document.getElementById('themeSwitch');
        if (!sw) return;
        var media = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)');

        function applyTheme(theme) {
          document.documentElement.dataset.theme = theme; // switch CSS variables
          if (window.osmLayer) {
            window.osmLayer.setUrl(theme === 'dark' ? window.osmDark : window.osmLight);
          }
          sw.checked = theme === 'dark';
        }

        var storedTheme = sessionStorage.getItem('themePreference');
        var initialTheme = storedTheme ? storedTheme : (media.matches ? 'dark' : 'light');
        applyTheme(initialTheme); // set initial state

        sw.addEventListener('change', function () {
          var newTheme = this.checked ? 'dark' : 'light';
          applyTheme(newTheme);
          sessionStorage.setItem('themePreference', newTheme);
        });

        var toggleBox = document.getElementById('themeToggle');
        if (toggleBox) {
          toggleBox.addEventListener('keydown', function (ev) {
            if (ev.key === 'Enter' || ev.key === ' ') {
              ev.preventDefault();
              sw.checked = !sw.checked;
              sw.dispatchEvent(new Event('change'));
            }
          });
        }

        media.addEventListener('change', function (e) {
          var newTheme = e.matches ? 'dark' : 'light';
          applyTheme(newTheme);
          sessionStorage.setItem('themePreference', newTheme);
        });
      });
    </script>


<!--

<script>
  // Build legend HTML with color squares for tooltip and modal.
  function buildLegendHTML(lang) {
    if (currentColoring === 'safecast') {
      var desc = translate('legend_safecast_desc');
      if (desc === 'legend_safecast_desc') {
        desc = "This is the traditional radiation level color scale adopted by Safecast in 2013 and used consistently on our maps since then. Users have found it intuitive to understand, as lower radiation levels are depicted as \"cool\", and higher levels as \"warm.\" The wide color range allows subtle differences to be distinguished instantly at a glance, and it is logarithmic, allowing users to easily see the relatively smaller differences in radiation levels close natural background, while allowing levels several orders of magnitude higher to be displayed as well.";
      }
      return '<p>' + desc + '</p>';
    }

    // Chicha 4-bin logic
    var key = 'legend_full_' + lang;
    var txt = translate(key);
    var parts = txt.split('\n\n');
    function stripBullet(line) {
      return line.replace(/^■\s*/, '');
    }
    function square(color) {
      return '<span class="legend-square" style="background:' + color + ';"></span>';
    }
    return parts.map(function(p){
      var lines = p.split('\n').map(function(line){
        // These thresholds are matched by text in translations
        if (line.includes('0–11')) return square('#008000') + stripBullet(line);
        if (line.includes('11–30')) return square('#FFD700') + stripBullet(line);
        if (line.includes('30–100')) return square('#FF4500') + stripBullet(line);
        if (line.includes('>100')) return square('#000000') + stripBullet(line);
        return line;
      }).join('<br>');
      return '<p style="margin:0 0 1em 0;">' + lines + '</p>';
    }).join('');
  }

  // Display the full legend text in current language.
  // Exposed so marker popups reuse the same modal.
  function openLegendModal() {
    if (window.__hideLegendHint) {
      window.__hideLegendHint();
    }
    var lang = (typeof currentLang !== 'undefined') ? currentLang : 'en';
    var html = buildLegendHTML(lang);
    var box = document.getElementById('legendText');
    if (box) box.innerHTML = html;
    var modal = document.getElementById('legendModal');
    if (modal) modal.style.display = 'flex';

  // Build HTML for info modal from translation text
  function buildInfoHTML(txt) {
    return txt.split('\n\n').map(function(p){
      return '<p style="margin:0 0 1em 0;">' + p.split('\n').join('<br>') + '</p>';
    }).join('');
  }

  // Turn license mentions into modal triggers so readers stay on the map page.
  function decorateLicenseLinks(txt) {
    if (typeof txt !== 'string' || !txt) {
      return txt;
    }
    var withMitAnchor = txt.replace(/<a[^>]*href=\u0022\/LICENSE\u0022[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/a>/gi, function(_, label) {
      return '<a href="#" class="license-link" data-license="mit">' + label + '</a>';
    });
    var withCc0Anchor = withMitAnchor.replace(/Creative Commons 1\.0(\s*\(CC0\))?/gi, function(match) {
      return '<a href="#" class="license-link" data-license="cc0">' + match + '</a>';
    });
    return withCc0Anchor;
  }

  // Open a specific license modal based on the identifier requested by the user.
  // We fetch the source file lazily so embedded binaries stay in sync with
  // the repository licenses even when served offline.
  function openLicenseModal(code) {
    if (!code) return;
    var selector = '.license-modal[data-license="' + code + '"]';
    var modal = document.querySelector(selector);
    if (!modal) return;

    var body = modal.querySelector('[data-license-url]');
    if (body) {
      var loadedState = body.getAttribute('data-license-loaded');
      var loadingState = body.getAttribute('data-license-loading');
      if (loadedState !== 'true' && loadingState !== 'true') {
        var url = body.getAttribute('data-license-url');
        if (url) {
          body.textContent = 'Loading…';
          body.setAttribute('data-license-loading', 'true');

          var handleSuccess = function(text) {
            body.textContent = text;
            body.setAttribute('data-license-loaded', 'true');
            body.setAttribute('data-license-loading', 'false');
          };

          var handleError = function(err) {
            if (window.console && console.error) {
              console.error('Failed to load license text for', code, err);
            }
            body.textContent = 'Unable to load the license text. Please download it from the repository.';
            body.setAttribute('data-license-loaded', 'error');
            body.setAttribute('data-license-loading', 'false');
          };

          if (window.fetch) {
            fetch(url, { cache: 'no-store' })
              .then(function(resp) {
                if (!resp.ok) {
                  throw new Error('HTTP ' + resp.status);
                }
                return resp.text();
              })
              .then(handleSuccess)
              .catch(handleError);
          } else {
            var xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
            xhr.open('GET', url, true);
            xhr.onreadystatechange = function() {
              if (xhr.readyState === 4) {
                if (xhr.status >= 200 && xhr.status < 300) {
                  handleSuccess(xhr.responseText);
                } else {
                  handleError(new Error('HTTP ' + xhr.status));
                }
              }
            };
            xhr.onerror = function() { handleError(new Error('network error')); };
            xhr.send();
          }
        }
      }
    }

    modal.style.display = 'flex';
  }

        html.push('<p class="api-card-desc">' + desc + '</p>');
      }
      if (linkText && linkText !== 'api_example_' + example.key + '_link') {
        html.push('<a class="api-card-link" href="' + example.url + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener">' + linkText + '</a>');
      }
      if (noteText && noteText !== 'api_example_' + example.key + '_note') {
        html.push('<p class="api-card-note">' + noteText + '</p>');
      }
      html.push('</article>');
    });
    html.push('</div>');
    var more = translate('api_more_docs');
    var moreLink = translate('api_more_docs_link_label');
    if (more && more !== 'api_more_docs') {
      var suffix = '';
      if (moreLink && moreLink !== 'api_more_docs_link_label') {
        suffix = ' <a href="/api/docs" target="_blank" rel="noopener">' + moreLink + '</a>';
      }
      html.push('<p class="api-more">' + more + suffix + '</p>');
    }
    return html.join('');
  }

  // Open modal with legal, source or license text
  function openInfoModal(topic) {
    if (window.__hideLegendHint) {
      window.__hideLegendHint();
    }
    if (topic === 'api') {
      var boxApi = document.getElementById('infoText');
      if (boxApi) {
        boxApi.innerHTML = buildApiHTML();
      }
      var headApi = document.getElementById('infoTitle');
      if (headApi) {
        headApi.textContent = translate('api_title');
      }
      var modalApi = document.getElementById('infoModal');
      if (modalApi) {
        modalApi.style.display = 'flex';
      }
      return;
    }
    var box = document.getElementById('infoText');
    var infoText = translate(topic + '_full');
    if (topic === 'legal' && typeof window.supportEmail === 'string' && window.supportEmail.trim() !== '') {
      infoText += '\n\n' + translate('legal_contact') + ' ' + window.supportEmail.trim();
    }
    if (topic === 'license') {
      infoText = decorateLicenseLinks(infoText);
    }
    if (box) box.innerHTML = buildInfoHTML(infoText);
    var head = document.getElementById('infoTitle');
    if (head) head.textContent = translate(topic + '_title');
    var modal = document.getElementById('infoModal');
    if (modal) modal.style.display = 'flex';
  }

  // Use event delegation because popups are created dynamically.
  document.addEventListener('click', function(ev) {
    // open legend modal when risk link clicked
    if (ev.target.classList.contains('risk-link')) {
      ev.preventDefault();
      openLegendModal();
    }
    if (ev.target.classList.contains('live-chart-link')) {
      ev.preventDefault();
      const dataset = ev.target.dataset;
      if (!dataset.device) return;
      const fallback = {
        device: dataset.device,
        name: dataset.name || '',
        transport: dataset.transport || '',
        tube: dataset.tube || '',
        country: dataset.country || '',
        lat: dataset.lat || '',
        lon: dataset.lon || '',
      };
      openLiveModal(dataset.device, fallback);
    }
    // switch to track view when track link clicked
    if (ev.target.classList.contains('track-link')) {
      ev.preventDefault();
      viewTrack(ev.target.dataset.track);
    }
    // open info modal for attribution links
    if (ev.target.classList.contains('attr-link')) {
      ev.preventDefault();
      openInfoModal(ev.target.dataset.info);
    }
    if (ev.target.classList.contains('license-link')) {
      ev.preventDefault();
      openLicenseModal(ev.target.dataset.license);

      function getMapContext() {
        if (typeof map === 'undefined') return null;
        try {
          const center = map.getCenter();
          const bounds = map.getBounds();
          return {
            center: { lat: center.lat, lon: center.lng },
            zoom: map.getZoom(),
            bounds: {
              minLat: bounds.getSouth(),
              minLon: bounds.getWest(),
              maxLat: bounds.getNorth(),
              maxLon: bounds.getEast()
            }
          };
        } catch (e) {
          console.error("Context error:", e);
          return null;
        }
      }

      function markdownToHTML(text) {
        if (!text) return '';

        let html = text
          .replace(/&/g, '&')
          .replace(/</g, '<')
          .replace(/>/g, '>')
          .replace(/### (.+)/g, '<h3 style="margin: 20px 0 10px 0; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700;">$1</h3>')
          .replace(/## (.+)/g, '<h2 style="margin: 24px 0 12px 0; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700;">$1</h2>')
          .replace(/# (.+)/g, '<h1 style="margin: 28px 0 14px 0; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700;">$1</h1>')
          .replace(/\*\*(.+?)\*\*/g, '<strong>$1</strong>')
          .replace(/\*(.+?)\*/g, '<em>$1</em>')
          .replace(/`([^`]+)`/g, '<code style="background: var(--control-bg); padding: 2px 5px; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 0.9em;">$1</code>')
          .replace(/\[(.+?)\]\((.+?)\)/g, '<a href="$2" target="_blank">$1</a>');

        // Robust Markdown Table parser
        // We match from the first pipe to the last pipe in a greedy block
        html = html.replace(/((^|\n)\|[\s\S]*?\|($|\n(?![| \t]*\|)))/g, function (match) {
          let rows = match.trim().split('\n').map(r => r.trim()).filter(r => r.length > 0);
          if (rows.length < 2) return match;

          let out = '<div class="ai-table-container"><table class="ai-table">';
          let bodyRows = [];

          rows.forEach((row) => {
            if (row.match(/^\|?[\s|:-]+\|?$/)) return; // separator row

            let cols = row.split('|');
            // Remove leading/trailing empty cells if pipes were used as borders
            if (row.startsWith('|')) cols.shift();
            if (row.endsWith('|')) cols.pop();
            bodyRows.push(cols.map(c => c.trim()));
          });

          bodyRows.forEach((cols, rowIndex) => {
            out += '<tr>';
            cols.forEach(col => {
              if (rowIndex === 0) {
                out += `<th>${col}</th>`;
              } else {
                out += `<td>${col}</td>`;
              }
            });
            out += '</tr>';
          });

          out += '</table></div>';
          return out;
        });

        // Handle line breaks ONLY if they are not inside a table-container
        let parts = html.split(/(<div class="ai-table-container">[\s\S]*?<\/div>)/g);
        html = parts.map(part => {
          if (part.startsWith('<div class="ai-table-container">')) return part;
          return part.replace(/\n\n/g, '<br><br>').replace(/\n/g, '<br>');
        }).join('');

        return html;
      }

      function addMessageUI(role, text) {
        const row = document.createElement('div');
        row.className = `ai-msg-row ${role}`;

        const avatar = document.createElement('div');
        avatar.className = 'ai-avatar';
        if (role === 'user') {
          avatar.innerHTML = '<svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M20 21v-2a4 4 0 0 0-4-4H8a4 4 0 0 0-4 4v2"></path><circle cx="12" cy="7" r="4"></circle></svg>';
        } else {
          avatar.innerHTML = 'i';
        }

        const bubble = document.createElement('div');
        bubble.className = 'ai-bubble';

        if (role === 'bot') {
          bubble.innerHTML = markdownToHTML(text);
        } else {
          bubble.textContent = text;
        }

        const ts = document.createElement('div');
        ts.className = 'ai-timestamp';
        ts.textContent = new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });

        const wrapper = document.createElement('div');
        wrapper.appendChild(bubble);
        wrapper.appendChild(ts);

        row.appendChild(avatar);
        row.appendChild(wrapper);
        messagesEl.appendChild(row);
        messagesEl.scrollTop = messagesEl.scrollHeight;
        return bubble;
      }

      function executeMapAction(actionData) {
        if (!actionData || typeof map === 'undefined') return;
        try {
          if (actionData.action === 'panTo' && actionData.lat !== undefined && actionData.lon !== undefined) {
            map.panTo([actionData.lat, actionData.lon]);
          } else if (actionData.action === 'zoomTo' && actionData.level !== undefined) {
            map.setZoom(actionData.level);
          } else if (actionData.action === 'highlightLocation' && actionData.lat !== undefined && actionData.lon !== undefined) {
            const marker = L.circleMarker([actionData.lat, actionData.lon], {
              radius: 20,
              color: '#FF0000',
              fillColor: '#FF0000',
              fillOpacity: 0.3
            }).addTo(map);
            setTimeout(() => {
              if (map.hasLayer(marker)) map.removeLayer(marker);
            }, 5000);
          }
        } catch (e) {
          console.error("Action execution failed:", e);
        }
      }

      function submitMessage() {
        const text = msgInput.value.trim();
        if (!text || busy) return;

        busy = true;
        sendBtn.disabled = true;

        addMessageUI('user', text);
        const botBubble = addMessageUI('bot', translate('ai_thinking'));
        botBubble.classList.add('ai-thinking');

        msgInput.value = '';
        msgInput.style.height = '44px';

        let accumulated = '';
        function finish(success) {
          botBubble.classList.remove('ai-thinking');
          busy = false;
          sendBtn.disabled = false;
          msgInput.focus();
          if (success && accumulated) {
            chatHistory.push(
              { role: 'user', content: text },
              { role: 'assistant', content: accumulated }
            );
            if (chatHistory.length > 10) {
              chatHistory = chatHistory.slice(-10);
            }
          }
        }

        fetch('/chat', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({
            message: text,
            history: chatHistory,
            map_context: getMapContext(),
            source: 'widget',
            lang: currentLang,
            client_timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
          }),
        }).then(response => {
          const reader = response.body.getReader();
          const decoder = new TextDecoder();
          let buffer = '';

          function pump() {
            return reader.read().then(({ done, value }) => {
              if (done) { finish(true); return; }

              buffer += decoder.decode(value, { stream: true });
              const lines = buffer.split('\n');
              buffer = lines.pop();

              for (const line of lines) {
                if (!line.trim()) continue;
                try {
                  const ev = JSON.parse(line);
                  if (ev.type === 'text') {
                    if (botBubble.classList.contains('ai-thinking')) {
                      botBubble.classList.remove('ai-thinking');
                      accumulated = '';
                    }
                    accumulated += ev.text;
                    botBubble.innerHTML = markdownToHTML(accumulated);
                    messagesEl.scrollTop = messagesEl.scrollHeight;
                  } else if (ev.type === 'action' || ev.action) {
                    executeMapAction(ev);
                  } else if (ev.type === 'done') {
                    finish(true);
                  } else if (ev.type === 'error') {
                    botBubble.textContent = translate('ai_error') + ev.error;
                    botBubble.classList.remove('ai-thinking');
                    finish(false);
                  }
                } catch (e) { }
              }
              return pump();
            });
          }
          return pump();
        }).catch(err => {
          botBubble.textContent = translate('ai_connection_error') + err.message;
          botBubble.classList.remove('ai-thinking');
          finish(false);
        });
      }
    })();
  </script>

</body>

</html>

name: Deploy to Production

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: "1.24"
          cache: true
          cache-dependency-path: go.sum

      - name: Build unified server
        run: |
          go build -o safecast-new-map ./cmd/unified-server

      - name: Prepare MCP hints directory
        run: |
          mkdir -p hints
          cp -r cmd/unified-server/hints/* hints/

      - name: Setup SSH
        run: |
          mkdir -p ~/.ssh
          echo "${{ secrets.DEPLOY_SSH_KEY }}" > ~/.ssh/deploy_key
          chmod 600 ~/.ssh/deploy_key
          ssh-keyscan -H 65.108.24.131 >> ~/.ssh/known_hosts

      - name: Stop service
        run: |
          ssh -i ~/.ssh/deploy_key root@65.108.24.131 "systemctl stop safecast-new-map || true"

      - name: Deploy binary
        run: |
          rsync -avP -e "ssh -i ~/.ssh/deploy_key" ./safecast-new-map root@65.108.24.131:/usr/local/bin/safecast-new-map

      - name: Deploy hints
        run: |
          rsync -avP -e "ssh -i ~/.ssh/deploy_key" ./hints/ root@65.108.24.131:/root/safecast-mcp-server/hints/

      - name: Start service
        run: |
          ssh -i ~/.ssh/deploy_key root@65.108.24.131 "systemctl start safecast-new-map"

      - name: Verify deployment
        run: |
          ssh -i ~/.ssh/deploy_key root@65.108.24.131 "systemctl status safecast-new-map"

      - name: Update environment
        env:
          DATABASE_URL: ${{ secrets.DATABASE_URL }}
          ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
          DUCKLAKE_PG_URL: ${{ secrets.DUCKLAKE_PG_URL }}
          DUCKLAKE_DATA_PATH: ${{ secrets.DUCKLAKE_DATA_PATH }}
        run: |
          ssh -i ~/.ssh/deploy_key root@65.108.24.131 \
            "printf 'DATABASE_URL=${DATABASE_URL}\nDUCKLAKE_PG_URL=${DUCKLAKE_PG_URL}\nDUCKLAKE_DATA_PATH=${DUCKLAKE_DATA_PATH}\nMCP_HINTS_DIR=/root/safecast-mcp-server/hints\nANTHROPIC_API_KEY=${ANTHROPIC_API_KEY}\nCLAUDE_MODEL=claude-haiku-4-5-20251001\nMCP_BASE_URL=https://simplemap.safecast.org/mcp\n' > /root/safecast-mcp-server/.env"

      - name: Restart service with new config
        run: |
          ssh -i ~/.ssh/deploy_key root@65.108.24.131 "systemctl restart safecast-new-map && systemctl status safecast-new-map"

        run: |

        env:
          AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID: ${{ secrets.AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID }}
          AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: ${{ secrets.AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY }}
          AWS_DEFAULT_REGION: us-east-1

      - name: Cleanup
        if: always()
        run: |
          rm -f ~/.ssh/deploy_key

name: stable release

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write

# ---------- PORTABLE: Unified server without CGO (no DuckDB analytics) ----------
jobs:
  build_portable:
    if: contains(toJson(github.event.head_commit.message), 'stable release') || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          # Linux
          - { goos: linux,  goarch: amd64, goversion: "1.24", runner: "ubuntu-24.04" }
          - { goos: linux,  goarch: arm64, goversion: "1.24", runner: "ubuntu-24.04" }
          - { goos: linux,  goarch: 386,   goversion: "1.24", runner: "ubuntu-24.04" }
          # macOS
          - { goos: darwin, goarch: amd64, goversion: "1.24", runner: "macos-13" }
          - { goos: darwin, goarch: arm64, goversion: "1.24", runner: "macos-14" }
          # *BSD
          - { goos: freebsd, goarch: amd64, goversion: "1.24", runner: "ubuntu-24.04" }
          - { goos: freebsd, goarch: arm64, goversion: "1.24", runner: "ubuntu-24.04" }
          - { goos: openbsd, goarch: amd64, goversion: "1.24", runner: "ubuntu-24.04" }
          - { goos: openbsd, goarch: arm64, goversion: "1.24", runner: "ubuntu-24.04" }
          - { goos: netbsd,  goarch: amd64, goversion: "1.24", runner: "ubuntu-24.04" }
          # Windows
          - { goos: windows, goarch: amd64, goversion: "1.24", runner: "windows-latest" }
          - { goos: windows, goarch: arm64, goversion: "1.24", runner: "windows-latest" }

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: "${{ matrix.goversion }}"
          cache: true
          cache-dependency-path: go.sum

      - name: go mod tidy (POSIX)
        if: runner.os != 'Windows'
        shell: bash
        run: go mod tidy

      - name: go mod tidy (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: pwsh
        run: go mod tidy

      - name: Build unified server (POSIX)
        if: runner.os != 'Windows'
        shell: bash
        env:
          GOOS: ${{ matrix.goos }}
          GOARCH: ${{ matrix.goarch }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          export CGO_ENABLED=0
          VERSION=${{ github.run_number }}
          mkdir -p dist
          BIN="safecast-new-map_${GOOS}_${GOARCH}"
          GOFLAGS="-trimpath -buildvcs=false" \
          go build -tags netgo,osusergo \
                   -ldflags "-s -w -X main.CompileVersion=$VERSION" \
                   -o "dist/${BIN}" ./cmd/unified-server

      - name: Build unified server (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: pwsh
        env:
          GOOS: ${{ matrix.goos }}
          GOARCH: ${{ matrix.goarch }}
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
          $env:CGO_ENABLED = "0"
          $version = "${{ github.run_number }}"
          New-Item -Force -ItemType Directory dist | Out-Null
          $bin = "safecast-new-map_${{ matrix.goos }}_${{ matrix.goarch }}.exe"
          go build -tags "netgo,osusergo" `
                   -ldflags "-s -w -X main.CompileVersion=$version" `
                   -o "dist/$bin" ./cmd/unified-server

      - name: Upload portable artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: bin-${{ matrix.goos }}-${{ matrix.goarch }}
          path: dist/

# ---------- DUCKDB: Unified server with DuckDB analytics (Linux/amd64 + macOS) ----------
  build_duckdb:
    if: contains(toJson(github.event.head_commit.message), 'stable release') || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          # Linux amd64 in container
          - { target: linux_amd64_duckdb, goos: linux, goarch: amd64, goversion: "1.24", runner: "ubuntu-24.04", in_container: true }
          # macOS amd64/arm64: нативно
          - { target: darwin_amd64_duckdb, goos: darwin, goarch: amd64, goversion: "1.24", runner: "macos-13", in_container: false }
          - { target: darwin_arm64_duckdb, goos: darwin, goarch: arm64, goversion: "1.24", runner: "macos-14", in_container: false }

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      # --- Linux в контейнере ---
      - name: Build (Linux duckdb container)
        if: matrix.in_container == true
        uses: addnab/docker-run-action@v3
        with:
          image: golang:${{ matrix.goversion }}
          options: -v ${{ github.workspace }}:/build -w /build
          run: |
            set -euo pipefail
            export CGO_ENABLED=1
            export GOOS=${{ matrix.goos }}
            export GOARCH=${{ matrix.goarch }}
            VERSION=${{ github.run_number }}
            mkdir -p dist
            BIN="safecast-new-map_${GOOS}_${GOARCH}_duckdb"
            apt-get update && apt-get install -y gcc libc6-dev
            go get github.com/marcboeker/go-duckdb/v2@latest
            go mod tidy
            GOFLAGS="-trimpath -buildvcs=false" \
            go build -tags "netgo,osusergo,duckdb" \
                     -ldflags "-s -w -X main.CompileVersion=$VERSION" \
                     -o "dist/${BIN}" ./cmd/unified-server

      # --- macOS нативно ---
      - name: Set up Go (macOS)
        if: matrix.in_container == false
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: "${{ matrix.goversion }}"
          cache: true
          cache-dependency-path: go.sum

      - name: go mod tidy (macOS)
        if: matrix.in_container == false
        shell: bash
        run: |
          go get github.com/marcboeker/go-duckdb/v2@latest
          go mod tidy

      - name: Build (macOS duckdb)
        if: matrix.in_container == false
        shell: bash
        env:
          GOOS: ${{ matrix.goos }}
          GOARCH: ${{ matrix.goarch }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          export CGO_ENABLED=1
          VERSION=${{ github.run_number }}
          mkdir -p dist
          BIN="safecast-new-map_${GOOS}_${GOARCH}_duckdb"
          GOFLAGS="-trimpath -buildvcs=false" \
          go build -tags "netgo,osusergo,duckdb" \
                   -ldflags "-s -w -X main.CompileVersion=$VERSION" \
                   -o "dist/${BIN}" ./cmd/unified-server

      - name: Upload duckdb artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: bin-${{ matrix.target }}
          path: dist/

  release:
    needs: [build_portable, build_duckdb]
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - name: Download all artifacts
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          path: dist-raw/

      - name: Publish GitHub Release (tag latest)
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v2
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          tag_name: latest
          name: "download stable version - unified server with MCP + AI assistant"
          body: |
            ## Unified Server (Map + MCP + AI Assistant)
            
            This release contains a single unified binary with:
            - Radiation monitoring map server
            - MCP server for AI integration
            - Web chat interface (requires ANTHROPIC_API_KEY)
            - DuckDB analytics (in _duckdb variants)
            
            ### Usage
            
            **Basic (PostgreSQL only):**
            ```bash
            DATABASE_URL="postgres://user:pass@localhost/db" ./safecast-new-map_linux_amd64
            ```
            
            **With DuckDB analytics:**
            ```bash
            DATABASE_URL="postgres://..." DUCKDB_PATH="./analytics.duckdb" ./safecast-new-map_linux_amd64_duckdb
            ```
            
            **With AI assistant:**
            ```bash
            DATABASE_URL="postgres://..." \
            ANTHROPIC_API_KEY="your-key" \
            ./safecast-new-map_linux_amd64
            ```
            
            ### Endpoints
            
            - Map: http://localhost:8765/
            - MCP: http://localhost:8765/mcp-http
            - AI Chat: http://localhost:8765/assistant/
            - REST API: http://localhost:8765/api/
            - Swagger: http://localhost:8765/docs/
          prerelease: false
          files: dist-raw/**/*

        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: bin-${{ matrix.goos }}-${{ matrix.goarch }}

# ---------- DUCKDB: Unified server with DuckDB analytics (Linux/amd64 + macOS) ----------
  build_duckdb:
    if: github.server_url == 'https://github.com' && (contains(toJson(github.event.head_commit.message), 'stable release') || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch')
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:

        if: matrix.in_container == true
        uses: addnab/docker-run-action@v3
        with:
          image: golang:${{ matrix.goversion }}
          options: -v ${{ github.workspace }}:/build -w /build
          run: |
            set -euo pipefail
            export CGO_ENABLED=1
            export GOOS=${{ matrix.goos }}
            export GOARCH=${{ matrix.goarch }}
            VERSION=${{ github.run_number }}
            mkdir -p dist
            BIN="safecast-new-map_${GOOS}_${GOARCH}_duckdb"
            apt-get update && apt-get install -y gcc libc6-dev
            go get github.com/marcboeker/go-duckdb/v2@latest
            go mod tidy
            GOFLAGS="-trimpath -buildvcs=false" \
            go build -tags "netgo,osusergo,duckdb" \
                     -ldflags "-s -w -X main.CompileVersion=$VERSION" \
                     -o "dist/${BIN}" ./cmd/unified-server

      # --- macOS нативно ---
      - name: Set up Go (macOS)
        if: matrix.in_container == false
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: "${{ matrix.goversion }}"
          cache: true
          cache-dependency-path: go.sum

      - name: go mod tidy (macOS)
        if: matrix.in_container == false
        shell: bash
        run: |
          go get github.com/marcboeker/go-duckdb/v2@latest

      - name: Build (macOS duckdb)
        if: matrix.in_container == false
        shell: bash
        env:
          GOOS: ${{ matrix.goos }}
          GOARCH: ${{ matrix.goarch }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          export CGO_ENABLED=1
          VERSION=${{ github.run_number }}
          mkdir -p dist
          BIN="safecast-new-map_${GOOS}_${GOARCH}_duckdb"
          GOFLAGS="-trimpath -buildvcs=false" \
          go build -tags "netgo,osusergo,duckdb" \
                   -ldflags "-s -w -X main.CompileVersion=$VERSION" \
                   -o "dist/${BIN}" ./cmd/unified-server

        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: bin-${{ matrix.target }}
          path: dist/


            - AI Chat: http://localhost:8765/assistant/
            - REST API: http://localhost:8765/api/
            - Swagger: http://localhost:8765/docs/
          prerelease: false
          files: dist-raw/**/*

content.thinking:
The user is asking about how to proceed with migrating GitHub Actions to Codeberg Actions. Let me think about this.

Codeberg uses Gitea Actions, which is largely compatible with GitHub Actions syntax. However, there are some key differences:

1. **Runners**: Codeberg provides hosted runners (Forgejo runners), but they may differ from GitHub's ubuntu-latest. Codeberg uses `ubuntu-latest` but the actual runner environment may differ.

2. **Secrets**: Secrets need to be configured separately in Codeberg repo settings.

3. **Actions marketplace**: GitHub Actions (like `actions/checkout@v4`, `actions/setup-go@v5`) are mostly compatible but Codeberg/Gitea prefers using their own mirror or direct references.


4. **Deployment**: The SSH-based deployment workflow should transfer over without issues once the SSH key secret is configured in Codeberg.

5. **GitHub-agnostic tools**: The `gh` CLI and AWS CloudFront integrations aren't tied to GitHub specifically, so they'll work fine.

6. **DeepWiki**: This is GitHub-specific and won't be available on Codeberg.

7. **Release workflow**: Codeberg has its own release system, but the DeepWiki action won't work there since it's GitHub-exclusive.

For a migration strategy, the test and deploy workflows would run as-is, while the release workflow would need adjustments to use Codeberg's release API instead of GitHub's, and the DeepWiki workflow should be skipped entirely. Codeberg does provide hosted runners, so I don't need to worry about setting up self-hosted infrastructure. The main work is updating the release action syntax and adding the necessary secrets in Codeberg's repository settings.

The real question is whether to run everything on both platforms or keep Codeberg as a mirror that only runs tests while deployments stay on GitHub. Since Codeberg appears to be a secondary mirror for now, the cleanest approach would be to keep test and deploy workflows on both but only trigger actual deployments from the primary GitHub repository.

content.text:
Good question. Here's how I'd think about it:

## What each workflow needs

| Workflow | Codeberg feasibility | Recommendation |
|---|---|---|
| `test.yml` | ✅ Works as-is | Run on both — free CI coverage |
| `deploy.yml` | ✅ Works as-is | **GitHub only** — avoid double deployments |
| `release.yml` | ⚠️ Needs adaptation | GitHub only for now (uses GitHub Releases) |
| `deepwiki.yml` | ❌ GitHub-specific service | Skip permanently on Codeberg |

## Practical steps

**1. Enable Actions on Codeberg**  
Repo → Settings → Actions → Enable (it's off by default)

**2. Add secrets on Codeberg**  
Repo → Settings → Secrets — add `DEPLOY_SSH_KEY`, `DATABASE_URL`, etc. (same values as GitHub)

**3. Migrate `test.yml` first** (lowest risk)  
Just remove the `if: github.server_url` guard from that one job and push — verify it runs on both.

**4. Keep deploy on GitHub only**  
Prevents double-deploys. When Codeberg is no longer just a mirror (e.g. if you start merging PRs there), revisit.

**5. For `release.yml`**  
Gitea has its own release API. The `softprops/action-gh-release` action has a Gitea-compatible fork, but it's extra work. Leave GitHub-only for now.

**6. `deepwiki.yml`**  
Make the GitHub guard permanent (add a comment so nobody removes it by mistake).

## My suggested order

Start with just `test.yml` on both — it's the safest and gives you confidence the Codeberg runner environment works before touching deploy or release. Want me to make that change?

---
name: Codeberg Actions Migration Plan
description: Step-by-step plan for migrating GitHub Actions to also run on Codeberg
type: project
---

## Context

Safecast/safecast-new-map is now mirrored on Codeberg (https://codeberg.org/Safecast/safecast-new-map).
Both remotes are configured as push targets on `origin` — a single `git push` hits both.
All workflow jobs currently have `if: github.server_url == 'https://github.com'` to prevent them running on Codeberg until migration is complete.

## Workflow inventory & target state

| Workflow | File | Codeberg target | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Test | `test.yml` | ✅ Run on both | Pure Go tests, no secrets needed |
| Deploy | `deploy.yml` | ❌ GitHub only forever | Avoid double deployments to production |
| Release | `release.yml` | ❌ GitHub only for now | Uses GitHub Releases; revisit when Gitea release action is evaluated |
| DeepWiki | `deepwiki.yml` | ❌ Skip permanently | GitHub-specific external service |

## Migration steps (in order)

### Step 1 — Enable Codeberg Actions (manual, one-time)
- Go to https://codeberg.org/Safecast/safecast-new-map/settings
- Actions → Enable Forgejo Actions
- **Why:** Codeberg Actions are off by default; nothing runs until explicitly enabled.

### Step 2 — Add secrets on Codeberg (manual, one-time)
- Go to https://codeberg.org/Safecast/safecast-new-map/settings/secrets
- Add the same secrets as GitHub (for future use, even if not all needed yet):
  - `DEPLOY_SSH_KEY`
  - `DATABASE_URL`
  - `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`
  - `DUCKLAKE_PG_URL`
  - `DUCKLAKE_DATA_PATH`
  - `AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID`
  - `AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY`
- **Why:** Secrets are per-platform; Codeberg does not inherit GitHub secrets.

### Step 3 — Migrate test.yml (lowest risk, do first)
- Remove `if: github.server_url == 'https://github.com'` from `test.yml` job
- Push and verify the workflow runs successfully on Codeberg
- **Why:** No secrets, no deployment — safe to run on both with zero risk.

### Step 4 — Evaluate Codeberg runner environment
- Check that `actions/checkout@v4` and `actions/setup-go@v5` work correctly
- Codeberg supports most GitHub Actions from the marketplace via act runner
- Note any differences in runner behaviour (OS version, available tools)
- **Why:** Before migrating anything with secrets, confirm the runner works.

### Step 5 — Make deepwiki.yml guard permanent
- Add a comment to the `if:` condition: `# DeepWiki is GitHub-specific — never run on Codeberg`
- **Why:** Prevents accidental removal of the guard in future.

### Step 6 — Decide on release.yml (future)
- Option A: Keep GitHub-only (simplest — GitHub is canonical release platform)
- Option B: Adapt to also create Gitea releases on Codeberg using `https://github.com/akkuman/gitea-release-action` or similar
- **How to apply:** Only pursue Option B if Codeberg becomes an equal publishing platform (not just a mirror).

### Step 7 — Keep deploy.yml GitHub-only (permanent decision)
- The guard on deploy.yml should stay forever to avoid double-deploys
- Add a comment explaining this is intentional
- **Why:** Production deploys should have a single authoritative trigger.

## Current status (as of 2026-03-29)
- ✅ Codeberg remote added to git push
- ✅ All workflow jobs guarded with `if: github.server_url == 'https://github.com'`
- ⏳ Steps 1–7 not yet started
- Next action: Rob to enable Actions in Codeberg repo settings (Step 1), then we do Step 3
